comments.body:
Hi, time skipping only engages when there's no in-flight activities, etc. While your activity is running, it blocks the
time-skipping — so when you call testEnv.sleep("61 seconds") inside the activity, and the testing engine falls back to real time and this sleep will literally wait 60 seconds until the timeouts happened that's why the worker gets stuck. 

Was the test meant for activity timeouts and retries ?

@feiyang3cat I've tested just now with a simple app (`npx @temporalio/create@latest ./my-app` as instructed in https://docs.temporal.io/develop/typescript/set-up-your-local-typescript) and it reproduces.

https://github.com/ikonst/temporalio-sdk-java-issue-2246

To understand the issue:

1. Run the test and see it finish immediately.
2. Find the line that says `await testEnv.sleep('59 seconds');` (unlike what you say about time-skipping etc.)
3. Change it to 61 seconds and see that now the test hangs for a very long time.

title: Time-skipping past activity’s startToCloseTimeout causes worker not to close
